summary: The filing is a Form 6-K by Aura Minerals Inc., a foreign private issuer, reporting its Q1 2026 financial and operational results. It includes a letter from the CEO highlighting production growth, increased mineral reserves, and a record dividend of ~US$65 million (US$0.78 per share). No M&A, activist, or special situation is disclosed. This is a routine earnings release, not a special situation filing.
